name: MOONBASE
what: Text adventure: escape the damaged moon base. Two-word commands, 10 rooms; every game is shuffled.

name: Lunar Lander
what: Land on the pad before the fuel runs out. Easy and Hard. VT100, arrow keys.

name: Snake
what: Eat the food, grow, and do not hit the wall or yourself. Ten speed levels. VT100, arrow keys.

name: Tetris
what: Steer the falling pieces and clear the rows; levels speed up. VT100, arrow keys.

name: Breakout
what: Knock out the wall of bricks; three balls, faster each wall. VT100, arrow keys.

name: Battleship
what: You against the computer on two 10 x 10 seas; arrow-key aim or typed squares. VT100.

name: CanonBall
what: Your castle and cannon against the computer's: aim, fire, mind the wind; three levels. VT100. Stellar C.

name: CanonBall Solo
what: Aim the great cannon and knock down the castle in as few shots as you can. VT100. Stellar C.

name: Getting Warmer
what: Guess the number from 1 to 1000 in ten tries: higher or lower, warmer or colder. Plain text.

name: Pong
what: You on the right against the computer. VT100, arrow keys.

name: Racer
what: Keep the car on a scrolling, winding road. VT100, arrow keys.

name: Invaders
what: Two rows of six invaders and an arrow-key gun. VT100.

name: Tic-Tac-Toe
what: You are X against a simple AI.

name: Maze
what: VM1 builds a maze, VM2 solves it. Two programs, one file. VT100.

name: Lite-Writer 2
what: Full-screen word processor: word wrap, find, cut/paste, 4 save slots. VT100.
note: the 2026-10-03 keep-the-slots change is simulator-verified, not yet on hardware

name: ELIZA
what: The classic 1966 chatbot psychotherapist.

name: Banner
what: Prints what you type as big block letters.

name: GETSTR
what: The $C2 line-input opcode: read a line, print it back.

name: String Store
what: Keep three typed lines in slots and print them back.

name: Big Clock v3
what: Big seven-segment time, the day and the date from the RTC ($07); timer, hourly chime and alarm on Q. VT100.

name: Morse Sender v17
what: Type text; it is sent as Morse code on the Q output.

name: Morse Sender v18
what: The same, but every dot and dash is a 700 Hz tone on Q (RUNMC) - for a speaker; v17 is for keying real gear.

name: Morse Receiver v11
what: Key Morse on the Input switch; it learns your hand, and can put the text in a Lite-Writer 2 slot.
note: simulator-verified, not yet run on hardware

name: Morse Receiver v10
what: Key Morse on the Input switch; it learns your hand and prints the text.
note: simulator-verified, not yet run on hardware

name: Simple-Calc-5
what: 5-digit calculator, all in STELLAR bytecode.

name: Simple-Calc-8
what: 8-digit calculator, math in native 1802 via RUNMC.

name: Pi digits
what: The digits of pi, up to 1526, by the spigot; the inner loop is raw 1802 (RUNMC).

name: Pi digits Stellar only
what: The same pi spigot in pure STELLAR bytecode, up to 350 digits (18x slower).

name: Prime-Gen v07
what: Primes in a range you choose, using the native OUTDEC print.

name: Prime-Gen v05
what: Primes by odd-only trial division.

name: Prime-Gen v04
what: An earlier prime generator (multiply-back divide test).

name: Mandelbrot
what: The Mandelbrot set in ASCII.

name: Game of Life
what: Conway's Life on a 40x20 grid: a blinker and a glider. VT100.

name: Life Lab
what: Game of Life you seed yourself: draw cells, stamp 9 patterns, run and edit. VT100. Stellar C.

name: Sort visualiser
what: Watch a bubble sort as VT100 bars.

name: Starfield
what: Stars streaming outward; you pick how many. VT100.

name: Bouncing Ball
what: Two balls bouncing around the screen and off each other. VT100.

name: Starship
what: The COSMAC ELF starship logo in ASCII.

name: Front panel
what: Lights the Q lamp and counts $00-$1F on the hex display.

name: Mandelbrot x 4
what: Four VMs draw a quarter of the Mandelbrot set each. One file.

name: Maze Race
what: VM1 builds a maze; VM2 and VM3 race it, right hand against left. One file.

name: STELLAR ORBIT
what: Fly Apollo 7: launch, orbit, random emergencies, a timed de-orbit burn, the chutes, the recovery ship. Three VMs, one file. VT100, real-time clock.

name: Life Race
what: Game of Life in bytecode against native 1802, side by side. One file.

name: Race condition (VM1)
what: Two VMs share a counter: without a lock, counts go missing. Load this file first.

name: Race condition (VM2)
what: The second worker for the race-condition demo. Load after VM1.

name: FW-Checksum V0061.34
what: Checks the firmware after loading: prints 15 checksums to compare with the list in the file.
